title: Ollama update order (router to agent, text frame)
description: Orders an update of the Ollama that runs as the agent's child (facts.ollama_managed true, ADR-0021). The router chooses only the version: the agent downloads the archive from its own configured source, compares the source's checksum with sha256, refuses a downgrade and reports progress in the heartbeat field ollama_update. With facts.ollama_swap_gate it stops at state ready and swaps only on ollama-swap.

version.description: Ollama version without a leading v.

file.description: Archive name; must be the one that fits the agent's os and arch, else the agent refuses.

url.description: Where the router saw the archive. The Go agent ignores it and downloads from its own configured source; the test fake agent downloads from it.

size.description: Size of the archive in bytes (0 when unknown).
